attributes.name: steady_repetition
attributes.text: The same movement repeats many times at a steady rhythm.
attributes.definition: A movement cycle is performed several times in a row with similar timing between cycles.

attributes.name: single_occurrence
attributes.text: The movement happens once and does not repeat.
attributes.definition: There is one main movement phase between the start and end rest positions, with no repeated cycles.

attributes.name: sudden_onset
attributes.text: The main movement starts suddenly and is very fast.
attributes.definition: The joints accelerate sharply at the start of the main phase, giving a short burst rather than a smooth gradual motion.

attributes.name: held_still_pose
attributes.text: A pose is held still for a while in the middle of the action.
attributes.definition: After moving into position, the joints stay nearly motionless for a noticeable time before moving back.

attributes.name: slow_gradual_motion
attributes.text: The movement is slow and gradual.
attributes.definition: Joints move at low speed without sharp changes, so the main phase takes a long time.

attributes.name: returns_to_start_pose
attributes.text: The body returns to the same pose it started in.
attributes.definition: The final joint configuration is close to the initial one, after one outward-and-back movement.

attributes.name: ends_in_new_state
attributes.text: The body ends in a different pose or place from where it began.
attributes.definition: The final posture or position differs clearly from the start, such as standing to sitting, standing to lying, or a change of location.

attributes.name: alternating_sides
attributes.text: The movement is done on one side and then the other.
attributes.definition: A movement made by one limb or toward one side is followed by the matching movement with the other limb or toward the other side.

attributes.name: continuous_small_movements
attributes.text: The hands keep making small movements throughout the action.
attributes.definition: For most of the action the hands make low-amplitude movements without a clear start and end of a single stroke, while the body stays still.

attributes.name: short_jerks
attributes.text: The body makes one or a few short jerking movements.
attributes.definition: The head or upper torso moves abruptly forward or back in brief bursts, separated by stillness.

attributes.name: prolonged_hold
attributes.text: The key position is held for a long time, most of the clip.
attributes.definition: The hands or body stay in the main position for most of the clip, with only small adjustments, rather than a brief pause.
